description: Fires at Post-Delete (server decommission, after the Azure VM and its disks are destroyed) to remove the per-VM disk-encryption resources recorded by 'Azure CMK - Per-VM Disk Encryption Set': deletes the Disk Encryption Set (retrying while disks are still detaching), revokes the DES identity's key-access grant, and soft-deletes the per-VM Key Vault key (purge protection prevents a hard purge; Azure purges after the retention window). Uses only identifiers stored on the server; nothing recorded or already gone is a skip, not a failure. Ships disabled; enable together with the paired Post-Provision action.
name: Azure CMK - Remove Per-VM Disk Encryption Set
